title: aria vexans
intro: Aria vexans, commonly known as the "Sensitive Plant", is a species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. The health benefits of Aria vexans include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, reducing stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its sedative and anti-inflammatory properties, which can also help to lower blood pressure and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Aria vexans include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
